title: Figure 1: Hair sample site from reported "Skinwalker" sighting, grassy field by fence
description: Color photograph of a dry grassy pasture with a barbed-wire fence and a metal fence post, with an orange circle marking the spot at the base of the post where the hair sample was collected and an orange arrow labeled "North." The caption reads "Figure 1 - Hair Sample from reported 'Skinwalker' sighting on [redacted] property," with the property name redacted under 1843(a)(2). Text above notes the sample was collected during the March deployment and refers readers to Figures 12 and 13 for microscopic photographs.
